entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God of deception and lies on Theros, who strikes a deal with Ashiok to obtain a third city for the Returned.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker with horns and a smoke-wreathed face who makes nightmares real; here they do the bidding of Phenax in the fall of Iretis.

entities.name: King of Iretis
entities.description: Ruler of Iretis who stabs out both his eyes on learning that his wife and child have been killed.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: A minor city-state on Theros sacked by leonin and given to Phenax for the Returned.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Lion-folk whose sack of Iretis was set in motion by Ashiok's deception.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City on Theros from which the king's wife and child were traveling to Iretis.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The world where Phenax and Ashiok strike their bargain.

entities.name: The Returned
entities.description: Beings that Phenax wants to hold a third city.

events.summary: Phenax, invisible in the throne room, watches the king of Iretis stab out both his own eyes after hearing of the murder of his wife and child.
events.quote: It was the second stab into his other eye, the mortal shrieking all the while, that Phenax found so impressive.

events.summary: The old man's illusion fades and reveals Ashiok.
events.quote: the old man's form began to waver and shimmer.

events.summary: Ashiok reads the king's letters and saves them from the fire.
events.quote: Ashiok held the letters above the fire for a second, then stopped and brought them back, undamaged, to lay on the desk.

events.summary: Phenax confronts Ashiok about the deaths; Ashiok admits the story was invented but the family may die on the road.
events.quote: The story of their deaths I made up.

events.summary: Phenax warns Ashiok to show respect.
events.quote: Presume with me again, and I will erase you from existence.

events.summary: Ashiok reports that the leonin are sacking Iretis and that the city now belongs to Phenax.
events.quote: The leonin sacking of the city has already begun.

events.summary: Phenax asks Ashiok what boon is wanted; Ashiok reveals a love of making nightmares real.
events.quote: I have built a beautiful dream here in Iretis.

events.summary: Ashiok whispers a request to Phenax, who is surprised.
events.quote: You are sure, mortal? This is what you want?

events.summary: Phenax looks into Ashiok's essence, laughs, grants the wish and leaves.
events.quote: So be it, mortal. You shall have your wish.

relations.note: Struck a deal; Ashiok completed a task for the god in return for a boon.
relations.quote: You have completed your task, and you have completed it well, Mortal.
The story of their deaths I made up.
